digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler / GitHub Code Quality remediation
propositions: A subprocess env-inheritance bug in both _read_local_tickets and _read_local_ticket_full lets an ambient REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off suppress the live sync pull when no_sync=False; both are fixed to build an explicit env and strip the key on the live path.
Dead-copy _HAVE_ASTGREP capability flag is removed from test_conformance.py and test_coverage_reconstruction.py while the used copy in test_engine_b.py is retained.
A non-review (transform category) test is added to test_validation_depth.py proving input-contract validation is category-agnostic.
BatchRunner.run signatures are aligned by making agent_runner optional across base BatchRunner, DefaultBatchRunner, and CodeReviewBatchRunner for mypy override consistency.
An enumerated set of verified-dead symbols across reconciler and test modules is removed while symbols confirmed still in use are deliberately kept.
Change landed on Gerrit only after LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with lint, mypy, and F821 checks clean.
